settings.title: My spaces
settings.subtitle: A space is a shared home for data and people: everything inside is visible to its members only.
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave? You will only be able to come back with an invitation.
settings.leaveLastConfirm: You are the last member: once you leave, the space is deleted with all its data.
settings.empty: No spaces yet. Create your own — or ask someone who already has a space for an invitation link.
settings.createHint: You can invite others right after creating it.

members.title: Space members
members.subtitle: Whom to invite, who may do what and which links have been issued.
members.linkReady: The link is ready — valid for three days
members.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the link manually
members.kickConfirm: Remove? They will only be able to come back with a new invitation.
members.empty: No members yet — invite the first one.
members.revokeConfirm: Revoke the invitation? The link will stop working.
members.removed: The member has been removed from the space
members.loadFailed: Could not load the member list
members.invitationsLoadFailed: Could not load the invitation list

invite.hint: The link is single-use and lives for three days: one person comes in through it and gets exactly the permissions ticked below. Send it via any messenger.
invite.inviteeNameHint: The name goes into the greeting on the invitation page.
invite.permissionsRequired: Keep at least one permission — an invitation without permissions is useless

permissions.required: Keep at least one permission: without permissions a person is no longer a member of the space. To remove them completely, use “Remove”.
permissions.loadFailed: Could not load the member's permissions

error.notAMember: You are not a member of this space
error.memberNotFound: The member was not found in this space
error.cannotRemoveSelf: To remove yourself from the space, use “Leave”
error.emptyPermissions: Keep at least one permission for the member. To remove a person from the space, remove the member
error.permissionsExceedOwn: You cannot grant permissions you do not have yourself
error.lastPermissionManager: At least one member managing permissions must remain in the space. Grant this permission to someone else first
error.setPrimaryFailed: Could not change the primary space
error.loadFailed: Could not load the list of spaces
